runs.text: There are 17 FPGs in the Amazon. The Matis people are one of the FPGs in the Amazon. The Matis are a small tribe in the northeastern Brazilian Amazon, vulnerable to disease and often exploited by outsiders. There are no Christian resources in their language, and there are very few if any followers of Christ among them.

About half of the Matis have moved to towns for education and work, adopting a more urban lifestyle. Those who remain in the forest rely on hunting, gathering, fishing, and growing manioc. Their life expectancy is low, around 45 years due to disease and limited medical care. Rural Matis marry within the tribe and have many children, though many do not survive to age ten. More young Matis are leaving the rainforest and moving away from their grandparents’ traditional way of life.

The Matis believe in a life force called “xo,” which they try to influence through rituals and offerings. Some also think spirits inhabit rivers, trees, mountains, animals, and the sky, and that these spirits must be appeased to avoid harm. They
